ch13.anchor: set up a National Security Commission
ch13.note: The Central National Security Commission, established in 2013 under Party general secretary Xi Jinping, consolidating oversight of internal and external security. The book's second edition, from which this afterword comes, was written in its wake.
Qiangli jigou, the “organs of force” or “power organs”: the army, police, and security services, the coercive arms of the state; the phrase parallels the Russian siloviki.

ch13.anchor: the founding of the state on September 30, 1949
ch13.note: The People's Republic was proclaimed on October 1, 1949; September 30 was the close of the first Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, which elected the new government. The author dates the founding from that eve.

ch13.anchor: the crushing of the "Gang of Four"
ch13.note: Jiang Qing, Zhang Chunqiao, Yao Wenyuan, and Wang Hongwen, the radical leadership faction blamed for the Cultural Revolution, arrested in October 1976, a month after Mao's death.
